confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Food and drink anchors are more reliable than July accommodation rates, which vary by neighborhood and booking date. Cocktail and wine anchors lean on the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 2.9x beer, wine glass about 1.2x beer) because direct local knowledge is weaker. Euro prices converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR. The FX value comes from a search-result summary attributing it to the RBA homepage; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Southern European capitals with similar tourism demand (for example Madrid and Porto) for food and drink; accommodation reflects July peak-season pricing.
